name: Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Govt Adarsh ​​Residential Schools (SC) Scheme
benefit: **Free Services Provided:** - Board and lodging, meals, textbooks, uniforms, and water - Study materials, mid‑day meals, and other academic support - Ration card, PH identity card, and other entitlements, as applicable
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be currently studying in standard 9th to 12th in a recognized institution.1. The applicant must have passed the previous annual exam with at least 50% marks (or a government-sanctioned exemption). > **NOTE:** Returning students must have passed with at least a second class with  50% to be considered for re-admission.
